exposure: Cobas AmpliPrep/Cobas TaqMan HIV-1 Qualitative Test v2.0 (CAP/CTM v2.0) HIV-detected screening test
outcome: Positive predictive value (PPV) of Xpert EID
Negative predictive value (NPV) of Xpert EID
cohort: The study included 150 HIV-exposed infants from four tertiary sites in Gauteng Province, South Africa, who had birth testing performed with a CAP/CTM v2.0 HIV-detected screening test, a concurrent Xpert EID test, and a subsequent confirmatory CAP/CTM v2.0 test.
finding: The GeneXpert HIV-1 qualitative assay, as a consecutive test for specimens with an HIV-detected PCR screening result, demonstrated high sensitivity (96.5%), PPV (99.3%), and overall accuracy (96.1%), with the potential to improve PPV and reduce indeterminate rates in early infant diagnosis.
